name: viewability
description: Returns how viewable an element is

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:modules && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --minify --format=iife --global-name=viewability --outfile=dist/viewability.min.js && node scripts/create-cjs-wrappers.mjs
scripts.build:modules: esbuild src/index.ts src/vertical.ts src/horizontal.ts src/is-element-on-screen.ts --bundle --sourcemap --target=es2020 --outdir=dist --format=esm && esbuild src/index.ts src/vertical.ts src/horizontal.ts src/is-element-on-screen.ts --bundle --sourcemap --target=es2020 --outdir=dist --format=cjs --out-extension:.js=.bundle.cjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:coverage && npm run build && npm run test:package
